content:
Dear colleagues,

We incorporated Talmenta Inc. to transition mathematical research from the master-apprentice model to a management-based system, enabling mathematicians worldwide to profit from AI engineers and technology. We operate by dispatching research managers to working mathematicians, recruiting collaborators and experts.

Karthik Viswanathan is one of our first clients! We are running the below project for him. He raised an incredible $21,000 for this project and we are looking forward to see the best candidates. Aside from Karthik, a research manager and another expert mentor will be involved.

Best wishes
Jasper

Original job post from Karthik Viswanathan:
We are looking for 2 collaborators for the project, Formally verified autoresearch for theoretical mechanistic interpretability. 

The goal is to build theoretical foundations for mechanistic interpretability by asking how far frontier models can go in discovering and proving theorems about the internal computations of transformers. We are looking for a research scientist to work on the mechanistic interpretability side, and a research engineer to design the multi-agent harness for autoresearch. Both roles are part-time (10-15 hours/week) from September to November 2026, with a stipend of at least $1,000/month plus Claude Max and ChatGPT Pro subscriptions. You can find the details for the research scientist and research engineer roles here.

If you're interested in the mathematics of transformers, multi-agent orchestration, or autoresearch, you are strongly encouraged to apply. Applications are open until August 15.
Excited about this research direction? We would be happy to hear from you. Apply here to join the project!
Karthik got several applications! You may still consider applying and see if he accepts late applications for vetting.
